item.title: Make listItems follow next_cursor across pages
item.brief: Update listItems(transport) so it resolves to every item, in order, by following next_cursor until it is null or absent, passing the cursor back unchanged; the first request sends no cursor. Add tests with a fake transport covering multiple pages, a single page, absent next_cursor, and that the first request has no cursor. Update the README to document that listItems pages through the API. Make npm test pass. Commit the change; do not push.

item.title: Add cursor pagination to GET /items
item.brief: Implement the GET /items pagination contract in the shared contract: optional limit (1..100, default 20) and cursor query params, body {"items", "next_cursor"}, items ordered by id, next_cursor null on last page, 400 with {"error": ...} for invalid limit or cursor. Add unit tests covering paging, last page, default limit, and invalid inputs (at least two meaningful assertions per new function). Update the README to document the new query parameters and response shape. Make python3 -m unittest pass. Commit the change; do not push.

pr.body: Approach: cursor is the id of the page's last item; each request returns items with id greater than the cursor, sorted by id. limit and cursor are validated at the boundary: digit-only ASCII strings, bounded in length (limit 3 digits, cursor 18) before int(), so oversized input returns 400 instead of an uncaught ValueError. Files: api.py (list_items, _parse_limit, _parse_cursor, _is_decimal), test_api.py (paging, last page, default limit, exact-fill at limit 19, past-end cursor, limit bounds, invalid and oversized limit/cursor), README.md (query params and response shape). Checks: python3 -m unittest, 12 OK. Review: whole-change fail on bccae5a (oversized input crash), fixed in 500a0bc; delta pass on 500a0bc. Open follow-ups: get_item int() on unbounded path ids (pre-existing); zero-padded limits now rejected; README wording 'opaque' vs current plain-id cursor. The inventory-client listItems change is a separate sibling item and is not in this branch.
pr.summary: made GET /items return bounded pages. now can page with limit (1..100, default 20) and cursor. before: all 57 items, no next_cursor; now: page of items plus next_cursor (null on last page); invalid limit/cursor gives 400.
